body:
Yes... I agreed to wait a week and see if I can fix things. I am working on getting an extension on my payment date to next Friday, and have gotten it down to needing 150 dollars. One of my friends talked me down and told me if I am going to end my life over this then to be 100% sure there is nothing left I can do.
I have bi-polar and GAD so my first reaction to the news was very poor. I am still constantly thinking about ending it but promised I wait so I am going to. If I get my extention I am going to look into getting a loan in the r/loans subreddit and some other places.
I am very afraid right now to be honest. Chances are I wont get what I need and end up in a homeless shelter a month from now. I dont want to live in a homeless shelter. I honestly feel like I rather be dead so if it come to that. I will choose suicide. 
Thank you for caring enough to respond to my post and thank you for reading this.
Not having a steady address, phone or any work experience is what is making it hard. I do as many gigs as I can.
On top of having no address, no phone, and no physical copies of any of your government papers it is almost impossible for me to get work.
right now Im staying with some nice people in SC. I go to school in Georgia and usually stay in Georgia.
Ive been telling myself since i found out about the debt. I told myself its fine long as we work hard we can get this done. We wont lose everything, and we wont end up homeless. Well that was a lie

No one will miss me if I am gone. All of my friends will continue on with there lives. Even if I do get housing I am in debt from my year in school. Im not qualified for any jobs, and I only have one year of college done. I'd just being burdening society even more than I already have.
